Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, songwriter, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which became a viral sensation and eventually reached the Billboard Hot 100’s top 10. Known for his unconventional offbeat flow, distinctive voice, and West Coast sound, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable personalities in hip-hop. His success led to collaborations with major artists, including Cardi B, YG, and Lil Baby.

Beyond music, Blueface has remained a major topic of conversation because of his highly publicized relationships, family life, and viral social media moments. His complicated relationship with Chrisean Rock gained widespread attention through social media, reality television, and their frequent public disagreements. The two share a son, Chrisean Jr., while Blueface also has two children, Javaughn and Journey, with his former partner Jaidyn Alexis.

Over the years, Blueface has expanded his presence beyond music into reality television, business ventures, and livestreaming. Despite facing legal troubles and personal controversies, he continues to attract significant attention online. His family relationships, particularly his evolving relationship with Chrisean Rock and their son, remain major talking points among fans.
